Title: Aristocrat Comet Cabin Polycarbonate Hard Case 8-Wheel Trolley Bag, Green
Brand: Aristocrat
Highlights:
- Durable polycarbonate case: Crafted with a tough, scratch-resistant and water-resistant polycarbonate case designed to offer durability and withstand the rigors of regular travel.
- Lightweight travel companion: Designed in a compact, lightweight format, making it a convenient luggage choice for short trips and quick getaways.
- Smooth, stable 8-wheel mobility: Equipped with dual-spinner wheels that enable smooth, stable movement and effortless 360-degree maneuverability.
- Secure combination lock: Features a built-in combination lock to help keep your belongings secure throughout your journey.
- Spacious interior with sturdy zipper: Features a spacious, fully lined interior with organized compartments to pack clothes and travel essentials efficiently, secured by a high-quality, sturdy zipper for reliable closure.
- 3-year global warranty: Backed by a 3-year global warranty for added assurance and peace of mind.

Title: DesiDiya® 35 Feet Long LED Power Pixel Serial String Light, 360 Degree Light in Bulb | Copper Led Pixel String Light for Home Decoration,Diwali,Christmas(Warm White) Pack of 1
Brand: Desidiya
Highlights:
- Radiant Ambiance Creation: 💫 Elevate your indoor and outdoor spaces with the Desidiya LED Rice Light, a versatile 10-meter strip designed to bring a warm and enchanting glow to any setting.
- Versatile Decor Possibilities: 🏡 Whether you're decorating a room, patio, garden, or any festive occasion, these lights offer endless possibilities, adding a touch of magic to weddings, parties, or everyday spaces.
- 10-Meter Length: 📏 The generous length of the LED strip provides ample coverage, allowing you to effortlessly weave these lights through trees, around furniture, or along walls for a seamless and beautiful decoration.
- Warm White Radiance: ☀️ Emitting a cozy and inviting warm white light, these LED lights create a welcoming atmosphere, making them ideal for both intimate gatherings and festive celebrations.
- Indoor and Outdoor Durability: 🌧️ Designed for versatility, the Desidiya LED Rice Light is suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, bringing the beauty of warm white illumination to any space, regardless of the setting.
- Energy-Efficient and Long-Lasting: 🌍 Enjoy the beauty of these lights guilt-free as they are energy-efficient and designed for longevity, making them a sustainable and cost-effective choice for all your decorative lighting needs.

Title: Zebronics Foldable Mobile & Tablet Stand, Multi-Angle Adjustable, Supports Up to 30.48cm Devices, Lightweight & Portable Design (MTS30)
Brand: ZEBRONICS
Highlights:
- FOLDABLE DESIGN: Smart foldable structure allows easy storage and portability, making it perfect for travel, office, or home use.
- WIDE DEVICE COMPATIBILITY: Compatible with both mobile phones and tablets, supporting devices up to 30.48cm screen size.
- MULTI-ANGLE ADJUSTMENT: Easily adjust the viewing angle for comfortable video calls, streaming, reading, or browsing.
- LIGHTWEIGHT & PORTABLE: Compact and lightweight build makes it easy to carry in bags or pockets for on-the-go convenience.

Brand: Portronics
Highlights:
- MoDesk - a Premium Quality Mobile Holders for your Ofﬁce Desks. It can hold, on your work desk, any type of smartphone & tablets with size up to 7 inches easily
